SELECT bo.*, b.book_name AS bookName, b.main_img AS bookMainImg, s.name AS shopName, u.nickname AS userName FROM book_order bo LEFT JOIN book b ON bo.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN shop s ON bo.shop_id = s.id LEFT JOIN user u ON bo.user_id = u.id
ORDER BY bo.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT count(bo.id) FROM book_order bo LEFT JOIN book b ON bo.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN shop s ON bo.shop_id = s.id LEFT JOIN user u ON bo.user_id = u.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_order (order_no, book_id, shop_id, user_id, quantity, total_money, status, consignee_name, consignee_tel, consignee_address, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{bookId}, #{shopId}, #{userId}, #{quantity}, #{totalMoney}, #{status}, #{consigneeName}, #{consigneeTel}, #{consigneeAddress}, #{remark})
